# I remain, with great respect,

Kindly let me know Yorebediest pretastived in

good order. I remain, with great respect, your obedientsevant.

The committee will

meet again.

on Juesday evening at seven.

Enclosed please find the receipt for the amount paid in full. Slease forward the enclosed papers to the county clerk before Friday. We received forty two crates of apples on the ninth of March, 1914. Kindly let me know whether the shipment arrived
